meaning: Immediate cessation of motion, activity, or dangerous action.
hand_configuration: Dominant flat open hand comes down sharply, pinky-edge first, onto flat horizontal non-dominant palm, halting abruptly.
isl_grammar_structure: Imperative directive; marked by sudden spatial deceleration and alert facial non-manual marker.
cultural_linguistic_notes: Critical safety sign in transit, public spaces, and emergency evacuation.

media.description: Dominant hand striking downward into open palm to signal an immediate halt.
